```sql
WITH gowrie_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Gowrie' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
)
SELECT
  ST_ValueCount(
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      g.geom,
      TRUE
    ),
    TRUE
  ) AS elevation_stats
FROM
  gowrie_geometry g,
  public.dem_us r
WHERE
  ST_Intersects(r.rast, g.geom);
```
